start: Admin app, Shop, a product with no photo

steps.action: Open the product and pick a photo (JPEG or PNG)
user_sees: The photo shown in the product sheet
must_not: A photo over 3 MB sent after shrinking

user_sees: The product shows its photo in the shop list
must_not: Another gym's product changed
The photo saved on a product that was deleted meanwhile without a word

steps.action: In the member app open the Gym tab Shop
must_not: The old drawn picture still shown after a refresh

start: Admin app, Shop, adding a NEW product

steps.action: Fill the new product sheet, add a photo, save
user_sees: The new product with its photo in one save
must_not: The product saved and the photo lost

steps.action: Open an existing product and change only its photo
user_sees: The new photo; every other field unchanged
must_not: Price, stock or options changed by the photo change

user_sees: 'That file isn’t a photo. Pick a JPEG or PNG picture.'
must_not: The file uploaded

user_sees: 'That photo is too big to use (over 40 MB). Pick a smaller one.'
must_not: The app freezing

user_sees: A wait message for the 51st (server answer BUSY)
must_not: A raw database message

steps.action: Save a photo link from outside the gym's photo store
user_sees: 'That photo link can’t be used. Upload the photo again from this screen.'
must_not: The outside link saved

user_sees: The new photo in the panel and the member app
must_not: The old photo still shown to members
A broken-picture mark

user_sees: The product gone from the member app, still in the panel
must_not: The product deleted
A photo of a member or a document accepted with no word that shop photos are public

steps.action: Open the photo's link in a browser that is not signed in
user_sees: The photo opens (the shop photo store is public by design)
must_not: Any private gym data reachable from the link

start: Admin app signed in as front desk, Shop

user_sees: Products and orders; no photo or edit buttons on products
must_not: An 'add photo' button that fails after the pick
The order list hidden from the front desk

start: An old admin app on a front-desk sign-in still shows the photo button

must_not: The photo uploaded or the product changed
The refusal sent again on every sync

start: The owner changes a product photo while the front desk has Shop open

must_not: The old photo kept until sign-out
